sql:
CREATE TABLE "api_key" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"encrypted_key" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"last_used_at" timestamp,
	CONSTRAINT "api_key_user_id_unique" UNIQUE("user_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "chat" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"folder_id" text,
	"title" text,
	"selected_model" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"pinned" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "folder" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"name" text NOT NULL,
	"icon" text,
	"color" text,
	"order" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "message" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"chat_id" text NOT NULL,
	"role" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"order" integer NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE "message_part" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"message_id" text NOT NULL,
	"type" text NOT NULL,
	"order" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"text_content" text,
	"tool_call_id" text,
	"tool_call_name" text,
	"tool_call_args" json,
	"tool_result_id" text,
	"tool_result_content" json,
	"provider_metadata" json
);

CREATE TABLE "starred_model" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"model_id" text NOT NULL,
	"model_name" text NOT NULL,
	"provider" text NOT NULL,
	"context_length" integer,
	"pricing_prompt" numeric,
	"pricing_completion" numeric,
	"order" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "starred_model_user_id_model_id_unique" UNIQUE("user_id","model_id")
);
ALTER TABLE "chat" ADD CONSTRAINT "chat_folder_id_folder_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("folder_id") REFERENCES "public"."folder"("id") ON DELETE set null ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "message" ADD CONSTRAINT "message_chat_id_chat_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("chat_id") REFERENCES "public"."chat"("id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE "message_part" ADD CONSTRAINT "message_part_message_id_message_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("message_id") REFERENCES "public"."message"("id") ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action;
CREATE INDEX "chat_user_updated_idx" ON "chat" USING btree ("user_id","updated_at" DESC NULLS LAST);
